rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE appropriately, and notes uncertainty from a single still image/collapse artifact. Minor issue: it questions expansion stage despite provided lab grade and may undercall expansion/zona thinning.
Strong integration of age, male-factor diagnosis, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with probability estimate tied to embryo quality and endometrial thickness. Small inconsistency in discussing Gardner stage terminology versus the supplied lab description.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and mainstream IVF practice: recognizes age and morphology as favorable, 7 mm lining as borderline, and gives balanced comments on PGT-A. Slight overemphasis on lining thickness and some recommendations are more expert-opinion than guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, luteal optimization, lifestyle measures, and future evaluation if unsuccessful. Useful and nuanced, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
